title: Supply Tenure Coverage in C&I Termination Security
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: termination security: supply tenure coverage.

The termination security's supply portion is scaled by the contract's supply tenure, the whole months from the service start date to the handling date: 36 months or more scale it by 0.80, 12 months up to 35 months scale it by 0.90, and a shorter tenure leaves it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the supply portion by the figure shown.

Whole months are calendar months counted from the service start date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the service start date.

| Supply tenure (whole months) | Supply portion multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.80 |
| 12 to 35 | 0.90 |
| 11 or fewer | 1, unscaled |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Service start date | Handling date | Whole months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2023 | 14 March 2026 | 35 | 0.90 |
| 15 March 2023 | 15 March 2026 | 36 | 0.80 |
| 5 October 2025 | 4 October 2026 | 11 | 1 |
| 4 October 2025 | 4 October 2026 | 12 | 0.90 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A supply portion of $43706.00 on a contract with 20 whole months of supply tenure becomes 43706.00 multiplied by 0.90, that is $39335.40.
